cashback.name: SecurBank Cashback
cashback.intro: Earn 1% cashback on everything you buy, with 5% at supermarkets for your first three months. No annual fee.
cashback.earnLede: Cashback lands in your balance every month, automatically.

earn.title: Supermarkets, first 3 months
earn.text: Boosted cashback on your weekly shop, up to £100 in total.

earn.title: Everything else
earn.text: On every purchase, at home and abroad, with no cap.

earn.title: Paid automatically
earn.text: Credited to your balance each statement. Nothing to redeem.

cashback.estLede: Move the slider to your typical monthly card spend.
cashback.repExample: If you spend £1,200 at a purchase rate of 24.9% p.a. (variable), your representative rate is 24.9% APR (variable).

voyager.name: SecurBank Voyager
voyager.intro: Points on every pound, no fees when you spend abroad and four airport lounge passes a year.
voyager.headline: 2x
voyager.earnLede: Collect points on everyday spending and double them when you travel.

earn.title: Welcome bonus
earn.text: Bonus points when you spend £3,000 in your first three months.

earn.title: Spending abroad
earn.text: Two points per £1 in any foreign currency, with no transaction fee.

earn.title: Everything else
earn.text: One point per £1 at home. Redeem for flights, hotels or statement credit.

voyager.estLede: Move the slider to your typical monthly card spend.
voyager.repExample: If you spend £1,200 at a purchase rate of 22.9% p.a. (variable) with a £95 annual fee, your representative rate is 29.9% APR (variable).

clear.name: SecurBank Clear
clear.intro: Move existing card balances over and pay them down with 0% interest for up to 24 months.
clear.earnLede: Every repayment goes toward what you owe, not interest.

earn.title: 0% on balance transfers
earn.text: Transfer within 60 days of opening. A 3% fee applies.

earn.title: 0% on purchases
earn.text: Spread the cost of bigger purchases interest-free for a year.

earn.title: Low standard rate
earn.text: A lower rate when the offers end than most cards.

clear.estLede: Move the slider to the balance you want to transfer.
clear.repExample: If you spend £1,200 at a purchase rate of 21.9% p.a. (variable), your representative rate is 21.9% APR (variable).

starter.name: SecurBank Starter
starter.intro: A simple first card with a sensible limit, to help you build a credit history step by step.
starter.headline: 6 mo
starter.earnLede: Use it for small purchases, pay on time, and watch your score grow.

earn.title: Credit score in the app
earn.text: Track your score monthly and see what moves it.

earn.title: Limit reviews
earn.text: Pay on time and we review your limit after six months.

earn.title: Payment reminders
earn.text: Never miss a payment with reminders before the due date.

starter.estTitle: Pay in full, pay no interest
starter.estLede: Move the slider to see the interest you avoid each year by clearing your balance monthly.
starter.repExample: If you spend £1,200 at a purchase rate of 34.9% p.a. (variable), your representative rate is 34.9% APR (variable).
